rubrics.justification: Accurately interprets the provided Gardner 4AA data and appropriately notes limitations from not having the actual image; minor issue is calling expansion 4 'hatching'/'actively herniating,' which is somewhat imprecise versus standard Gardner staging.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, diagnosis, endometrium, cycle history, and sperm data with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is structured and mostly consistent, with a clear link from embryo quality and patient factors to prognosis; slight overprecision in additive probability adjustments and some speculative points reduce perfection.

Mostly aligned on SET and general IVF principles, but includes weaker or non-routine recommendations such as ERA after only failed transfers, immunologic/NK workup, and broad PGT-A endorsement in a good-prognosis 33-year-old.
Provides clear practical recommendations for transfer management and future planning, though some suggestions are more speculative than standard-of-care.
